# Prepublication Windows Maintenance Update Inputs

These three public files bind the exact separate-app 0.1.13 NSIS candidate from
Windows acceptance run `38400543084`, source `7ee1cab7278ed4dbb48542ce26305f74b989b9d3`.
The installed executable is the extracted installer payload, not the earlier raw
build executable. The installer is downloaded from that immutable CI artifact,
not committed here. No private key is present.

The existing catalog signer produced the descriptor and installer signatures
after guarded NSIS acceptance. The fixture does not assert a public release,
Mac/Linux support, full AI/Unity acceptance or a successful signed update. The
disposable lab must verify native cancellation, update, automatic restart and
unchanged separate companions. Its five-route feed is not public discovery.

Do not replace these signatures or carry a passing receipt to different bytes.
Unification remains deferred to 0.1.14 or later.
